entry_surfaces./: arcade game container — cyber dark board with reactive HUD, center swipe arena, and floating preview queue

layout.viewport_lock: Mobile-first full viewport (h-screen / h-[100dvh] max-w-md mx-auto relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between)
layout.desktop_support: Centered high-precision arcade cabinet simulator (max-w-md w-full sm:rounded-3xl sm:border sm:border-slate-800 sm:shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)])

sections.header: h-16 px-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-md z-30
sections.score_hud: py-2 px-6 flex justify-around items-center border-b border-slate-800/40 bg-slate-900/30
sections.game_stage: flex-1 relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center select-none touch-none cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing px-4 overflow-hidden
sections.main_arrow_arena: relative w-48 h-48 sm:w-56 sm:h-56 flex items-center justify-center rounded-3xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800/90 shadow-[inset_0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]
sections.bottom_control_bar: p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-950/80 border-t border-slate-800/60

REVERSE.label: SWIPE OPPOSITE
REVERSE.rule: Swipe towards the opposite direction (e.g., Arrow UP = Swipe DOWN)

queue_system.animation_behavior: When current main arrow is solved, the queue pops front; preview arrow 1 animates smoothly down into main position with scaling up, preview arrow 2 shifts to preview 1, and a new random arrow spawns at preview 2.

timer_system.visual_indicator: Radial glow ring or linear smooth depleting bar around main arrow arena, shifting from Emerald/Cyan -> Amber -> Crimson as time runs out.

controls.touch: TouchStart, TouchMove, TouchEnd with minimum delta threshold (30px) to trigger instant move without scroll interference
controls.mouse: MouseDown, MouseMove, MouseUp with click-drag vector detection (30px threshold), visual ghost trail drag indicator
controls.haptics: navigator.vibrate supported for successful swipe and game over vibrations

audio.engine: Web Audio API synth oscillators (zero external asset latency)

state_machine.IDLE_START: Hero title screen with 'Reverse Arcade', glowing rules breakdown card, high score badge, animated demo swipe prompt, and 'TAP OR SWIPE TO START' button.
state_machine.PLAYING: Active timer running, interactive gestures enabled, dynamic combo counter, real-time score display, queue animation.
state_machine.GAME_OVER: Instant freeze + screen shake glitch effect + red flash overlay. Displays Final Score, Best Record, New Record Badge (if beaten), Streak Breakdown, Reason ('Wrong Direction' or 'Time Out'), and instantaneous 'PLAY AGAIN' (Spacebar / Tap).

transitions.correct_feedback: Quick scale bump (scale: [1, 1.15, 1]) + directional particle burst in swipe vector

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.html font imports or frontend/src/index.css with @fontsource-variable/space-grotesk, @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans, and @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono.
2. Implement Web Audio API synthesizer module in frontend/src/lib/audio.ts for zero-asset, high-performance sound effects (correct, reverse, streak, fail, new-record).

3. Build the core game engine in frontend/src/lib/gameEngine.ts or a custom React hook (useGameEngine.ts) supporting instant pointer/touch swipe detection with preventDefault on game arena to block page scroll.
4. Implement preview queue where preview arrows smoothly step down into the main arrow slot using motion/react layout animations or keyed transitions.
5. Ensure high-contrast neon styling on Dark Obsidian theme (#0B0F19 background, #38BDF8 cyan for normal arrows, #FF3366 crimson for reverse arrows).
6. Ensure all UI controls and score displays have their specified data-testid attributes.
7. Guarantee mobile full-height responsiveness (dvh) and centered arcade container on desktop.
